document.abstract: A technical report of the third meeting of ISO/TC 36, Cinematography, which was held at Harrogate, England, June 16–20, 1958. This report summarizes the history of international standardization and the deliberations and conclusions of the meeting affecting international exchange of motion-picture films and television programs. A total of 33 resolutions were adopted by TC 36. Thirteen interim working groups were constituted by ISO/TC 36 to continue the work begun at Harrogate as well as to consider new items of international concern and interest.
